messages:
omar: Heads-up — need to reschedule the cross-func roadmap sync. Current Thurs 10:00 conflicts with infra deploy window for the next 3 weeks. Options: move to Wed 11:10, or switch to biweekly. Current agenda priorities: RFC reviews, design reviews, priority triage, decision-log updates. Who can own the agenda for the next two sessions?

katie: Wed 11:10 works for me. can we keep it 30m? APAC folks prefer a slightly later start. :wave:

sanjay: I lean biweekly to reduce context switching, but Wed 11:10 is fine for the short term. if weekly, i'd only be present on Tue/Wed, so @omar plz keep notes + decision log updated.

liz: I have a standing all-hands Tue morning, so Wed 11:10 is better. +1 for rotating steward — i'll take the steward role for the next session if no one else volunteers.

paul: quick ask — can we shorten to 30m and keep deep design reviews async unless flagged? also add "prod incidents / SLO impacts" to the agenda when relevant.

deploy-bot: Reminder: infra-deploy-window scheduled Thu 09:30-11:30 for next 3 weeks — recurring conflict detected.

omar: Sounds like consensus: move to Wed 11:10 weekly, 30m, with rotating steward. Liz will steward the next session — thanks! I'll draft a compact agenda template and pin it in the thread. First agenda item next week: RFC review for batching/kv-cache change. @paul pls drop platform impact notes into the doc. :handshake:

katie: Adding to my calendar now. If someone can't make it, ping here and we'll swap steward or mark items to be async-reviewed. :thumbsup:

sanjay: Works for me. If we want to try biweekly later we can poll after two cycles.

liz: I'll shepherd next week's agenda. Draft agenda I plan to use:

```
1) Quick rollcall & 30s updates (5m)
2) RFC review: batching + KV cache changes (10m) — owner: @omar
3) Priority triage (5m) — owner: rotating steward
4) Decision log updates + actions (5m)
5) Any blockers / SLO impacts (5m)
```

I'll post the link to the doc in #product and attach the RFC PR.

omar: thanks everyone. I'll add the RFC link and a short rollback checklist to the doc. If no objections by EOD, I'll update the recurring invite to Wed 11:10.

paul: no objections from me. thx.

katie: ✅

sanjay: ✅

liz: ✅ — leaving doc comments on the RFC tonight.
